date_note: The RNBO page, published 24 November, says the exercises had concluded; it gives no dates for them.
exec: Ukraine's cyber coordination centre and Health Ministry trained health-sector staff in cyber defence in exercises with an online seminar, CTF contests and a tabletop exercise.
geo_basis: Ukraine's National Security and Defence Council, Kyiv; the page names no exercise location
org: National Coordination Center for Cybersecurity (NKCK), Ukraine
plain: Ukraine's national cyber coordination centre and the Health Ministry ran three days of cyber exercises for the healthcare sector. The page says an international online seminar was part of it.

sources.name: RNBO of Ukraine: НКЦК РНБО посилює кіберзахист сфери охорони здоров’я

summary: Ukraine's National Coordination Center for Cybersecurity under the NSDC and the Ministry of Health held the three-day MEDCYBER SHIELD 2026 cyber exercises for healthcare, supported by JICA, according to the NSDC page. The programme included Capture the Flag contests, a tabletop exercise and an international online seminar.
title: Ukraine's NKCK and Health Ministry run MEDCYBER SHIELD 2026 healthcare cyber exercises
